verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Slack has a general Web API, an official CLI, and Bolt-based app scaffolding (`slack create`) plus canvas/list building blocks, which are the underlying tools developers use to build Slack apps, but none of the evidence explicitly documents Block Kit, modals, interactive buttons, or structured message layouts — the specific UI primitives the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Block Kit, modal views, button/interactive components, and message layout builders (Block Kit Builder).
